skills: Python, SQL, Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Pandas, NumPy, Azure, Kubernetes, ETL, Data Analysis
full_description: At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst The opportunity In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence. A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) — EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate — directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value. Your Key Responsibilities The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms — with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry — transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations. The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting — tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination — and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement. Skills And Attributes For Success Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing. Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation. Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting. Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including: Workflow execution metrics OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends Drift detection signals ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including: Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals Virtualization platforms — Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware Kubernetes cluster concepts — pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization Network fundamentals — VLANs, DNS, IP management Storage and compute provisioning concepts Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources. Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting. Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources. Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources. Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks: Python (pandas, NumPy, requests) PowerShell Bash Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences. Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones. To qualify for the role, you must have experience with Power BI report and dashboard development — 5–7 years. Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations — 5–7 years. ELK stack data analysis — Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development — 3–5 years. SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores — 5–7 years. KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services. Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent). Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data — metrics, logs, workflow events and traces. Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms. Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis. Workflow orchestration data analysis — Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics. OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting. Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis. Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts — sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data. Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI). Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation — 3–5 years. PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection. Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery. Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred). Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred). Ideally, you'll also have Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired). Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired). Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have). ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have). Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms. Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data. Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs. Experience with Terraform state data and infrastructure drift analysis. Experience operating within a managed services or large enterprise shared services environment. What We Look For A data-driven professional with a genuine curiosity for infrastructure platform operations and a talent for turning complex, multi-source operational data into clear and actionable insight. We are looking for an individual who combines strong analytical and visualization skills with practical infrastructure and platform automation awareness — enabling them to serve as the trusted analytical partner to EY's HCSP engineering team and I&O leadership, measuring the platform's impact, identifying improvement opportunities and demonstrating the value of automation at scale. What We Offer We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer: Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Scenario analyses and decision support for sourcing and planning. Measurement and validation of savings and strategic initiatives. Qualifications And Experience Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, economics, supply chain, analytics or a related field; postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Strong capability in reporting and data analysis; experience with SQL, ERP systems or data platforms is preferred. Experience working with procurement, commodity, manufacturing or steel-related data is an advantage. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate analysis to deadlines. Skills and attributes Strong analytical thinking and attention to data quality. Ability to explain complex findings in clear, practical business language. Structured problem-solving and sound judgment. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Collaborative approach and comfort working across functions, geographies and levels. Discretion when handling commercial, supplier and cost information. full_description: About the role Destinare Services is seeking Application Security Engineers to identify, reproduce, and assess vulnerabilities in applications powered by large language models (LLMs), agents, and connected tools. You will review source code, trace data flows, assess access controls, and create reproducible tests for issues involving sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, prompt injection, and tool abuse. Candidates need relevant security experience in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript. Responsibilities Conduct secure code reviews of LLM applications, agent frameworks, MCP servers, and connected tools. Trace data flows across files, callbacks, registries, and background jobs to find routes that bypass security controls. Assess authentication, authorisation, least privilege, tenant isolation, trust boundaries, and approval workflows. Investigate sensitive information disclosure, excessive functionality, overly broad permissions, and unsafe agent autonomy. Write reproducible exploit tests and verify that patches prevent exploitation. Use CodeQL, Semgrep, SARIF results, and manual analysis to investigate vulnerabilities, including logic and authorisation flaws. Map confirmed findings to relevant CWE categories and document clear technical evidence. Review security patches and commit history to understand root causes and assess remediation. For reviewer-level assignments, lead code reviews and validate the accuracy and clarity of findings. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in application security, secure code review, penetration testing, or vulnerability research. Reviewer-level candidates: at least 5 years of relevant experience, including leading code reviews. Strong source-to-sink data-flow reasoning and ability to explain how a security control can be bypassed. Understanding of authentication, authorisation, least privilege, tenant isolation, trust boundaries, and approval workflows. Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, especially Sensitive Information Disclosure and Excessive Agency, as well as prompt injection and tool abuse. Ability to map findings to CWE categories such as CWE-200/201, CWE-532, CWE-284/285/862/863, and CWE-250/269. Experience writing reproducible tests that distinguish vulnerable behaviour from patched behaviour. Experience with CodeQL or Semgrep, reading SARIF results, and understanding the limits of pattern-based scanners. Hands-on familiarity with LLM tool calling, agents, MCP, RAG, memory, and tracing. Relevant technologies include LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs, and OpenTelemetry. Working knowledge of Docker and Git, and ability to review security patches and commit history. Clear written technical English. Relevant experience in at least one language is required: Python: Security reviews involving unsafe deserialisation, subprocess and shell tools, logging and tracing leaks, asynchronous task queues, or dependency-injected authentication in FastAPI. Go: Security reviews involving MCP and agent tool servers, os/exec and file tools, context and middleware authentication, or broadly scoped Kubernetes or cloud credentials. TypeScript/JavaScript: Security reviews involving server actions and API routes, middleware authentication gaps, client-versus-server data exposure, MCP tool scopes, or OAuth token handling. Nice to have OSWE, OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, or a similar security certification. CVE credits, bug bounty experience, or published security research. Experience with AI red-teaming or LLM evaluation.
